meta.name: enhance-prompt
meta.description: Transforms vague UI ideas into polished, Stitch-optimized prompts. Enhances specificity, adds UI/UX keywords, injects design system context, and structures output for better generation results.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将模糊的UI想法转化为精准的设计提示词
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为UI生成写提示词但常得不到满意结果
copy.tagline_en: Turn vague UI ideas into polished design prompts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write prompts for UI generation and get unsatisfying results

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会将你模糊的 UI 想法改写成清晰、结构化的提示，加入设计系统信息和 UI 术语，便于 Stitch 生成更好的界面。
howto.when: 当你想要打磨一个 UI 提示、或者上次生成的结果不好时，Claude 就会触发这个技能来帮你优化。

say.text: 帮我写一个登录页面的 Stitch 提示。
say.note: Claude 会输出一个包含设计系统和页面结构的完整提示。

say.text: 我有个很模糊的想法，帮我优化成 Stitch 能用的提示。
say.note: Claude 会分析你的描述并自动补全缺失的元素。

howto.what_en: Claude transforms vague UI ideas into well-structured, Stitch-optimized prompts by adding design system context, UI/UX keywords, and a clear page structure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to polish a UI prompt before sending to Stitch, or to improve a prompt that produced poor results.

say_en.text: Write a Stitch prompt for a login page.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a complete prompt with design system and structure.

say_en.text: I have a fuzzy idea; help me optimize it into a Stitch prompt.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes your description and fills in missing elements.
